title: 第84章生死危机青璇脱困第83章 尸阴宗传承青璇的誓言
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
第84章生死危机，青璇脱困！
陆成脸上露出笑容，看向青璇，道：“自然可以！”
说罢，陆成也不再废话，径直走向一道锁链的底端阵法处。
他缓缓升空，看向面前的黑色阵法纹路。
阵法看起来极其复杂，陆成用肉眼观看，竟无法分辨出每一道纹路。
阵法呈圆形，直径大约一米左右。
圆形阵法内，黑色纹路纵横交错，陆成现在是筑基境初期。
他的视力早已达到翻天覆地的变化，在未踏入这尸阴宗遗址之前，方圆几公里一切物品，在他的视线内，一切可见，无所遁形！
而此刻，他突破至筑基初期，灵液早已对他的五官进行淬炼。
而此刻，以他的视力，竟然无法看清这圆形阵法的黑色纹路。
可想而知，这阵法，是由一位化神境修士所刻下！
而这阵法，足有十个，分别分布在宫殿内四周，每一个阵法上，连接着一个锁链，贯穿青璇的体内。
没有化神境以上的实力和专修阵法之道的修士，根本没有能力摧毁此阵法。
但陆成不一样，他手中的掌天鼎涌出的白色光芒，能够做到暴力摧毁！
他来到另外一处阵法，发现这座刻在墙上的阵法与之前那一个阵法，一模一样！
青璇看着陆成不断穿梭在十道锁链的末端，脸上时而露出凝重和豁然的表情。
没来由的，她美目突然紧张起来。
她看着陆成双手捧着掌天鼎，掌天鼎内正涌出白色亮光。
在亮光涌出的一霎那，她的浑身更是剧烈地颤抖起来。
想到万年前的一幕，她心怀期待地迎向洛玉青，洛玉青看向她的眼神也充满爱意。

她终于不负重托，完成洛玉青交给她的任务，让她成为尸阴宗的宗主，她做到了。
而洛玉青却提出想要观看尸魂幡，却在拿到尸魂番的一霎那，瞬间翻脸，以雷霆手段镇压她。
而尸阴宗的一众长老和弟子，更是在她的亲眼目睹下，相继被血屠。
而她，也被镇压，洛玉青最后来找到她，面带笑意，道：“青儿，谢谢你为我做的这一切，我会感谢你的！”
说罢便刻下阵法后转身离去。
洛玉青冷笑的神情和离去的背影，犹如一把利刃，一刀刀刻在她心上！
这一刻，她等了很久很久！
足足一万年！
脱困之日就在眼前，她如何不激动！
就在陆成手中的掌天鼎即将触碰到其中一座锁链末端的阵法时，锁链突然哐啷作响！
陆成被吓了一跳，脸色剧变，连忙后退。
转而他便看到虚空中剧烈颤抖的青璇，待看到她美目中的愤怒后，他明白了原因。
content_en:
Chapter 84: Life and death crisis, Qingxuan escapes!
A smile appeared on Lu Cheng's face, he looked at Qingxuan and said, "Of course you can!"
After that, Lu Cheng stopped talking nonsense and walked straight to the formation at the bottom of a chain.
He slowly rose into the air and looked at the black formation patterns in front of him.
The formation looked extremely complicated. Lu Cheng couldn't distinguish every line when looking at it with his naked eyes.
The formation is circular in shape, about one meter in diameter.
Within the circular formation, black lines crisscrossed each other. Lu Cheng was now at the early stage of the Foundation Establishment Realm.
His eyesight has already undergone earth-shaking changes. Before he stepped into the ruins of the Corpse Yin Sect, everything within a few kilometers of his sight was visible and nothing could be hidden!
At this moment, he had broken through to the early stage of foundation building, and the spiritual liquid had already tempered his facial features.
But at this moment, with his eyesight, he could not clearly see the black lines of this circular formation.
It is conceivable that this formation was carved by a monk in the realm of gods!
There are ten of these formations, distributed around the palace. Each formation is connected to a chain that runs through Qingxuan's body.
A monk who does not have the strength above the realm of gods and specializes in formation formations has no ability to destroy this formation.
But Lu Cheng is different. The white light emanating from the Palm Cauldron in his hand can violently destroy it!
He came to another formation and found that the formation engraved on the wall was exactly the same as the previous one!
Qingxuan watched Lu Cheng constantly shuttle between the ends of the ten chains, with a solemn and relieved expression on his face from time to time.
For no reason, her beautiful eyes suddenly became nervous.
She saw Lu Cheng holding the Palm Cauldron in both hands, and white light was pouring out of the Palm Cauldron.
The moment the light came out, her whole body began to tremble violently.
Thinking of the scene ten thousand years ago, she greeted Luo Yuqing with anticipation, and Luo Yuqing looked at her with eyes full of love.
She finally lived up to the great trust and completed the task assigned to her by Luo Yuqing, making her the leader of the Corpse Yin Sect. She did it.
However, Luo Yuqing wanted to see the Soul Banner, but the moment she got the Soul Banner, she turned against her and suppressed her with thunderous means.
And all the elders and disciples of the Corpse Yin Sect were slaughtered one after another under her own eyes.
And she was also suppressed. Luo Yuqing finally came to find her and said with a smile: "Qing'er, thank you for everything you have done for me, I will thank you!"
After saying that, he carved the formation and turned around to leave.
Luo Yuqing's sneering look and his leaving back were like a sharp blade, engraved on her heart!
She had been waiting for this moment for a long, long time!
A full ten thousand years!
The day of escape was just around the corner, how could she not be excited!
Just when the Zhang Tianding in Lu Cheng's hand was about to touch the formation at the end of one of the chains, the chain suddenly clanged!
Lu Cheng was startled, his expression changed drastically, and he quickly backed away.
Then he saw Qingxuan shaking violently in the void. After seeing the anger in her beautiful eyes, he understood the reason.
